# Introduction

It has been said by someone that "the proper study of mankind is man." I will not
oppose the idea, but I believe it is equally true that the proper study of God's elect
is **God**; the proper study of a Christian is the *Godhead*.[^1]

> There is something exceedingly improving to the mind
> in a contemplation of the Divinity.

<Scripture ref="Malachi 3:6">For I am the Lord, I change not.</Scripture>

<Quote source="Augustine, Confessions">
  Thou hast made us for thyself,
  and our heart is restless until it rests in thee.
</Quote>

<Note>Spurgeon was twenty years old when he preached this sermon.</Note>

## Three points

1. First, the *nature* of God is unchangeable.
2. Second, see [his promises](https://example.com/promises) and his `threatenings`.
   They are also unchanging.
